16	// Trivial memento that keeps the information about how given request was delivered:
17	// in case of success this means offset (if acks > 0), or error code.
18	struct DeliveryMemento {
19	
20	  // Pointer to byte array that was passed to Kafka producer.
21	  // We use this to tell apart messages.
22	  // Important: we do not free this memory, it's still part of the 'ProduceRequestHandler' object.
23	  // Future work: adopt Kafka's opaque-pointer functionality so we use less memory instead of
24	  // keeping whole payload until we receive a confirmation.
25	  const void* data_;

28	  const int32_t error_code_;

36	public:
37	  virtual ~ProduceFinishCb() = default;

41	  virtual bool accept(const DeliveryMemento& memento) PURE;

51	public:
52	  virtual ~KafkaProducer() = default;
53	
54	  /*
55	   * Sends given record (key, value) to Kafka (topic, partition).
56	   * When delivery is finished, it notifies the callback provided with corresponding delivery data
57	   * (error code, offset).
58	   *
59	   * @param origin origin of payload to be notified when delivery finishes.
60	   * @param topic Kafka topic.
61	   * @param partition Kafka partition (as clients do partitioning, we just reuse what downstream
62	   * gave us).
63	   * @param key Kafka message key.
64	   * @param value Kafka message value.
65	   */
66	  virtual void send(const ProduceFinishCbSharedPtr origin, const std::string& topic,
67	                    const int32_t partition, const absl::string_view key,
68	                    const absl::string_view value) PURE;
69	
70	  // Impl leakage: real implementations of Kafka Producer need to stop a monitoring thread, then
71	  // they can close the producer. Because the polling thread should not be interrupted, we just mark
72	  // it as finished, and it's going to notice that change on the next iteration.
73	  // Theoretically we do not need to do this and leave it all to destructor, but then closing N
74	  // producers would require doing that in sequence, while we can optimize it somewhat (so we just
75	  // wait for the slowest one).
76	  // See https://github.com/edenhill/librdkafka/issues/2972
77	  virtual void markFinished() PURE;
78	};

All changes are complete. Here's a summary of what I implemented to preserve and forward Kafka message headers through the mesh proxy.

## Changes

**`produce_outbound_record.h`**
- Added a new `Header` struct (`key_`/`value_` as `absl::string_view`, with `operator==`).
- Added `headers_` as the 5th member of `OutboundRecord` (`std::vector<Header>`), placed after `value_` and before `error_code_`/`saved_offset_`.
- Updated the constructor to `(topic, partition, key, value, headers)` with initialization order `{topic, partition, key, value, headers}`.

**`produce_record_extractor.cc`**
- Instead of discarding parsed headers, it now collects them into a `std::vector<Header>` and passes them into the constructed `OutboundRecord` — this is what makes end-to-end header preservation work.

**`upstream_kafka_client.h`**
- Changed `KafkaProducer::send` to `void send(const ProduceFinishCbSharedPtr callback, const OutboundRecord& record)`.
- Added an include (+ Bazel dep) for `produce_outbound_record.h`.

**`upstream_kafka_client_impl.h` / `.cc`**
- Extended `LibRdKafkaUtils` with `convertHeaders(...)` and `deleteHeaders(...)`.
- Implemented both in `LibRdKafkaUtilsImpl` (`convertHeaders` builds `RdKafka::Headers`, returning `nullptr` and freeing on any `add` failure).
- `RichKafkaProducer` now stores a `const LibRdKafkaUtils&` reference. To keep that reference valid in production (the delegating ctor previously passed a temporary), the impl now uses a `CONSTRUCT_ON_FIRST_USE` default singleton via `getDefaultInstance()`.
- Rewrote `send` to match the new interface and implement the required error handling:
  - Convert headers; if `convertHeaders` returns `nullptr`, abort and notify via `ProduceFinishCb` **without** calling `deleteHeaders`.
  - `produce` is now called with 10 arguments (adding `librdkafka_headers` before `msg_opaque`).
  - On produce failure, call `deleteHeaders` (librdkafka did not take ownership) then notify.
  - On success, do **not** delete — ownership is transferred to librdkafka.

**`produce.cc`**
- `startProcessing` now calls `producer.send(shared_from_this(), outbound_record)`.

**BUILD**
- Added `produce_outbound_record_lib` dep to `upstream_kafka_client_lib` and `//source/common/common:macros` to `upstream_kafka_client_impl_lib`.
